divergences.reason: Adds wp14r-resilient-development-v6 to FREEZE_MODULES so the protocol can select the builder that owns a v6 receipt. Selection stays safe because the selected builder rebuilds the whole receipt from source and compares it.

Converts the live child-environment regression into a supersession record: freeze v5 must now fail to rebuild, and its retained receipt bytes must stay untouched. The live regression moved to tests/test_wp14r_freeze_v6.py.
divergences.recoveryNote: The archived bytes are CRLF, matching how the file was written when the v5 receipt sealed it. A newline-normalised recovery hashes to 4153cafbfbff742398b3d200050a9504f775b262ffc4ca74477da745a54534b3 and is not the frozen artifact.

purpose: The freeze-v5 receipt pins the exact source that authorized it. Freeze v5 closed the paired resource gate and ran 40 of 160 matrix jobs cleanly before halting on an adapter defect, not a protocol one. Correcting that defect re-froze the scientific design as freeze-receipt-v2.json, which freeze v5 binds byte-exact, so v5 can no longer be rebuilt. Every divergence is declared here with the frozen hash and a location the frozen bytes are still recoverable from, so the v5 provenance chain and its retained halt stay complete and auditable.

rebasedScientificFreeze.reason: Freeze v5 binds benchmarks/scenarios/wp14-development/freeze-receipt-v1.json byte-exact and re-derives it from source. Those bytes are untouched, but the adapter correction means v1 no longer rebuilds, so v6 binds the re-frozen freeze-receipt-v2.json instead. The scientific design is identical: the same 16 cells, 10 arms, 160 jobs, panel, denominators and master seed 7.
